blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Distilling vision-language features into 3D Gaussian Splatting yields a language map that can be queried with arbitrary text. In deployment, however, a small set of user-specified targets must be reliably located, which current distilled maps often miss, while open-vocabulary queryability for other words must remain intact. We propose a training-free, target-aware refinement of an already-distilled language map. Guided by a text-promptable segmenter, the visual embedding inside each detected target region is blended with the target text embedding, a convex combination whose coefficient sets the amount of injected prior, while non-target regions are left untouched. Injecting too much overwrites appearance cues and general queryability, so we seek, for each target, the smallest coefficient that still lets it win, and we obtain every coefficient in closed form, leaving no hyperparameters to tune. We further identify a failure mode of injection in language-goal localization. Text embeddings share a common component, and injecting them makes the standard cosine read-out query-agnostic, which a centering step in the read-out removes. Across three benchmarks, the refinement consistently improves open-vocabulary segmentation, roughly doubling the base mIoU on Replica, and localizes language goals more reliably than the base map. It also transfers as a plug-in to off-the-shelf field-based and object-level language maps and supports a real-world demonstration in which a legged robot navigates to natural-language goals. Project page and code: https://lab-of-ai-and-robotics.github.io/target-aware-langmap/

blocks.en: I INTRODUCTION
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: A reliable spatial representation is central to robotic autonomy, since a robot must understand its environment before it can act within it across tasks such as localization, navigation, and manipulation. The recent emergence of Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF) [ 21 ] and 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) [ 12 ] has made photorealistic spatial representation possible. Moreover, by combining these representations with vision language models [ 25 ] , a scene is no longer restricted to a fixed set of semantic labels, and open-vocabulary NeRF and 3DGS representations [ 13 , 37 , 24 ] have become possible, allowing the space to be queried with arbitrary natural language.
blocks.zh: 可靠的空间代表是机器人自主的核心,因为机器人必须了解其环境,然后才能在内部采取行动,完成本地化、导航和操纵等任务。 最近出现的"神经辐射场"(NERF)[21]和"3D高斯平板"(3DGS)[12]使得光现实化的空间表现成为可能. 此外,通过将这些表述与视觉语言模型相结合[25],场景不再局限于固定的语义标签,开放-vobulary NeRF和3DGS表述[13,37,24]成为可能,使得空间可以被任意的自然语言所询问.

blocks.en: However, existing methods for building such language maps tend to fall toward one of two ends of a spectrum, and we instead pursue the practical middle ground, precise localization of user-specified targets without giving up open-vocabulary generality. Closed-set methods are trained per scene with semantic supervision [ 18 , 38 ] and are accurate on their predefined labels, but cannot be queried with any word outside that set. Open-vocabulary methods instead distill vision-language features and respond to arbitrary text [ 13 , 24 , 37 ] . Yet because the distillation blends surrounding context into each feature, the resulting relevancy can be spatially diffuse, so a query often yields a plausible heatmap whose peak is not always precise enough to serve directly as a navigation goal. We first tried to sharpen such maps with a training-free post-processing, but found that the limitation is already present in the 2D features themselves, whose top-ranked retrieval is often wrong before any lifting to 3D. Purely post-hoc processing is therefore insufficient, which motivates injecting the target text directly into the features.
blocks.zh: 然而,建立这种语言地图的现有方法往往会落到一个频谱的两端之一,而我们则追求实际的中间点,精确地将用户指定的目标本地化,同时又不放弃公开的省略。 每个场景都经过语义监督[18,38]的闭合设置方法训练,并在预定义的标签上准确,但不能用该套外的任何单词来询问. 开放式省略方法取而代之地提炼出视觉语言特征并回应任意文本[13,24,37]. 然而,由于蒸馏法将周围环境融合到每个特征中,由此产生的关联性可以进行空间扩散,因此查询往往会产生一种合理的热图,其峰值并不总是精确到能够直接作为导航目标。 我们首先尝试用免训练后处理来磨练出这样的地图,但发现限制本身已经在2D特性中存在,在任何提升到3D之前,其排名最高的检索往往是错误的. 因此,纯粹的后热处理不足,这促使目标文本直接注入到特征中去.

blocks.en: To this end, we propose a training-free, target-aware refinement of an already-distilled language map. Given a small set of user-specified target words, we localize each target in every training view with a text-promptable segmenter, retain the open-vocabulary base from a class-agnostic segmenter, and encode both with a vision-language model. Within each target region the visual embedding is then blended with the target text embedding, a convex combination whose coefficient decides how much prior is injected, while non-target regions are left untouched. Such coefficients are conventionally treated as hyperparameters, swept over a grid or set by heuristics. Injecting too much overwrites the region’s visual embedding and erodes the appearance cues and general queryability that make the map open-vocabulary. We therefore formulate the problem as finding the smallest coefficient that still lets each target win, and we solve it in closed form. Each detection yields this minimum as a flip point, and the per-target strength is read off the knee of the capture curve that the flip points form, leaving no hyperparameters to tune. This minimal injection, together with the untouched non-target regions, is what keeps the refined map open-vocabulary.
blocks.zh: 为此,我们提议对已经过时的语言地图进行无培训、有针对性地改进。 由于用户指定的目标字组很小,我们在每个训练视图中将每个目标定位在文本可提示分解器上,从班级不可知分解分解器中保留了可打开的分解基,并用视觉语言模型编码两种. 在每个目标区域内,视觉嵌入再与目标文字嵌入相混合,这是对流组合,其系数决定了注入之前的多少,而非目标区域则未受影响。 这种系数通常作为超参数处理,被覆盖在网格上,或被高压设定。 注射过多地覆盖了该地区的视觉嵌入,并侵蚀了使地图开放的外观提示和一般可查询性。 因此,我们把问题表述为找到最小的系数,使每个目标仍然能够取胜,我们以封闭的形式解决这个问题。 每一次检测都得出这个最小值作为翻转点,而每个目标强度被从翻转点所形成的捕获曲线的膝盖上读取出,没有超参数来调取. 这种最小的注射量,加上未触及的非目标区域,使得精密的地图可以畅通无阻。

blocks.en: Because the refinement acts only on the 2D features before distillation, it is pipeline-agnostic and drops into different language maps as a plug-in module, from dense feature fields to object-level maps. It also carries over to language-goal localization, where the map must turn a query word into a 3D goal position. We observe a failure mode rooted in the geometry of contrastive vision-language embeddings [ 19 , 22 ] . Text embeddings cluster around a shared direction, so injecting them plants this common component in the map, and under the standard cosine read-out every query then retrieves the same dominant regions. A centering step in the read-out removes this common mode. Notably, centering barely changes the base map but is decisive on the refined one, after which the refined map localizes goals more reliably than the base across Replica [ 30 ] , ScanNet [ 3 ] , and HM3D-Semantics [ 35 ] . We summarize our contributions as follows: • A training-free, target-aware refinement that makes user-specified targets reliably retrievable while keeping the map open-vocabulary, with each target’s injection strength obtained in closed form instead of tuned. • A centered read-out that identifies and removes the query-agnostic bias of injection, turning the refined map into a reliable source of language-goal locations. • Consistent gains in segmentation and localization on three benchmarks, plug-in transfer to field-based and object-level maps, and a real-world demonstration on a legged robot.
blocks.zh: 由于精度在蒸馏前只作用于2D特性,因此它是管道-可知的并会作为插件模块滴入到不同的语言地图中,从密集的特性字段到对象级地图. 它还延续到语言目标本地化,其中地图必须将查询词变成3D目标位置. 我们观察到一种失败模式,它植根于对比视觉语言嵌入的几何学[19,22]. 文本围绕一个共同的方向嵌入了集群,所以将它们植入了地图中这个共同的组件,在标准同位素读出每个查询后,再取回相同的主导区域. 读出时的中取步骤会去除这个常见模式. 值得注意的是,以基本地图为中心并不改变底图,而是在精细地图上起决定性作用,之后精细地图更可靠地将目标定位于整个复制[30]、斯堪的纳特网[3]和HM3D-语义[35]。 我们总结我们的贡献如下: • 改进培训,不附带任何目标,使用户指定的目标能够可靠地取回,同时保持地图的通路,使每个目标的注射力以封闭形式获得,而不是调制。 二. 支助 集中读出,识别并去除输入的查询-不可知偏差,将精细地图变为可靠的语言-目标位置来源. · 在分块化和本地化方面,在三个基准上取得持续进展,将插件转移到基于实地和对象的地图上,并在一个有腿机器人上进行现实世界的演示。

blocks.en: II Related work
blocks.zh: 二. 有关工作

blocks.en: II-A Open-vocabulary 3D language maps
blocks.zh: II-A 开放式3D语言地图

blocks.en: Semantic mapping has long attached labels to reconstructed geometry, but classical systems remain closed set, recognizing only the categories their segmenters were trained on [ 20 ] . Open-vocabulary maps remove this limit by distilling vision-language embeddings into 3D, first over point clouds and implicit fields [ 23 , 9 , 13 ] and more recently into 3D Gaussian Splatting [ 24 , 37 , 33 ] , with closed-form solvers reducing the distillation cost [ 34 , 10 ] and online variants embedding language during SLAM [ 15 , 6 ] . Dedicated benchmarks now track the open-vocabulary quality of such maps [ 11 ] . All of these works concern how to build the map, and to our knowledge none refines the language field of an already-built one, so our training-free, target-aware refinement is complementary to all of them.

blocks.en: II-B Language-goal localization and navigation
blocks.zh: 二-B 语文-目标定位和导航

blocks.en: A language map supports many downstream tasks, and this work concerns the one closest to deployment, turning a query word into a navigation goal. Spatial memories built from vision-language features have enabled language-driven navigation over grids and implicit fields [ 7 , 28 , 16 ] , zero-shot object search [ 4 ] , scene graphs queried through language model reasoning [ 32 , 5 ] , and Gaussian memories for goal retrieval [ 36 ] , evaluated under object-goal navigation protocols [ 1 , 14 ] . Across these systems the goal is typically read out by raw cosine similarity between the query embedding and the stored features. We show that this standard read-out breaks once text embeddings are injected into the map, and that a centering step in the read-out restores and then surpasses the base retrieval.
blocks.zh: 语言地图支持许多下游任务,而这项工作涉及最接近部署的,将查询词变成导航目标. 由视觉语言特征所构建的空间记忆使得语言驱动在网格和隐含字段上进行导航[7,28,16],零镜头对象搜索[4],场景图表通过语言模型推理被询问[32,5],高斯记忆用于目标取回[36],在对象目标导航协议下评价[1,14]. 在这些系统中,目标通常通过查询嵌入和存储特性之间的原始同位素相似性来读出。 我们显示,一旦将文本嵌入到地图中,这个标准读出中断,读出中的一个中心步骤会恢复,然后超过基础检索.

blocks.en: III Method
blocks.zh: 页:1 方法

blocks.en: Our method refines an existing 3D Gaussian language map so that user-specified targets become reliably retrievable while the map stays open-vocabulary. For every training view we localize each target, blend its visual embedding toward the target text by a coefficient obtained in closed form, and lift the refined per-view features into 3D. At query time a centered read-out turns the refined map into 3D goal locations for navigation. Fig. 2 summarizes the pipeline.
blocks.zh: 我们的方法完善了已有的3D高斯语言地图,使用户指定的目标在地图保持开通时可以可靠地取回. 对于每一个训练观点,我们将每个目标定位,将其视觉嵌入到目标文本上,用一个以封闭形式获得的系数来混合,并将精细的每个视图特征提升到3D. 在查询时中心读出后,将精制的地图转换为3D目标位置进行导航. 图2概述了管道。

blocks.en: III-B Target-Aware Feature Injection
blocks.zh: III-B 目标识别特征注射

blocks.en: We construct a target-aware feature map for every training view and then lift the per-view maps into 3D, in our implementation with a closed-form feature splatting solver [ 34 ] . For each view, a class-agnostic segmenter, instantiated with SAM 2 [ 26 ] in automatic mask generation mode, produces masks that cover the view, and a vision-language model, for which we use SigLIP 2 [ 31 ] , encodes each masked region into a D D -dimensional embedding. These region embeddings form the open-vocabulary base of the map. For each target word t k t_{k} , a text-promptable segmenter, SAM 3 [ 2 ] , localizes the target with a per-target mask in the same view. The shared encoder embeds that region into u v , k u^{v,k} , and the text anchor f ⁡ ( t k ) f(t_{k}) comes from the paired text encoder. blocks.en: IV-A 1 Datasets and metrics
blocks.zh: 数据集和衡量标准

blocks.en: We evaluate on 8 Replica [ 30 ] , 10 ScanNet [ 3 ] , and the 4 multi-room HM3D-Semantics [ 35 ] scenes that LagMemo [ 36 ] curates from GOAT-Bench [ 14 ] . On each per-scene map we run two evaluations, rendered-view open-vocabulary segmentation and language-goal localization for navigation. For segmentation the target queries are each scene’s annotated categories, which serve as both the deployment vocabulary and the evaluation set. For each test view we label every pixel by the argmax \argmax cosine similarity to the GT class names and score mIoU and mAcc against the rendered GT, ignoring unlabeled pixels. On HM3D-Sem, whose scenes carry over a thousand free-form categories, we follow the common practice of restricting to frequent categories [ 27 ] and keep per scene those covering at least 0.5 % 0.5\% of the labeled pixels. The navigation-oriented localization study of Sec. IV-D instead queries the shared object-level HOV-SG vocabulary [ 32 ] . Beyond the main comparison we run two further studies, each with a single protocol across all scenes. Table 4 ablates injection strength, comparing our adaptive knee against the base and a range of fixed strengths. To check that injection preserves open-vocabulary behavior, the held-out study in Table III splits each scene’s classes 50/50 into an injected target set and a never-injected held-out set, scores both with the full class set, and reports the held-out change from the base.

blocks.en: IV-A 2 Implementation details

blocks.en: Our pipeline builds a base from SAM 2 [ 26 ] masks encoded by SigLIP 2 [ 31 ] and applies the proposed hyperparameter-free refinement to it, lifting the per-view features with the feature-splatting solver [ 34 ] . On Replica and ScanNet the geometry is reconstructed from RGB alone, matching the RGB-only baselines, while the house-scale HM3D-Sem scenes, where RGB-only reconstruction is unreliable, are initialized with depth following the RGB-D setting of LagMemo [ 36 ] . The language distillation and refinement are identical in both the RGB and RGB-D settings. On HM3D-Sem the geometry is trained on every rendered frame while the language stages of feature extraction, injection, and evaluation run on every fifth frame. The read-out constants are fixed across all scenes and datasets, a kept fraction of 4 % 4\% for the centered read-out and 0.5 % 0.5\% for the raw read-out, so each is scored at its own operating point, with a cluster radius of 0.3 0.3 m and K = 5 K{=}5 .

blocks.en: We compare against two field-based 3DGS language maps listed in Table I , each run in its published configuration and scored with our protocol. LangSplat [ 24 ] distills three-granularity SAM regions encoded by OpenCLIP [ 8 ] into a per-scene autoencoder latent, and Feature-3DGS [ 37 ] distills LSeg [ 17 ] features into the Gaussians. For each baseline, +Ours applies the same refinement to its per-view features, changing only the text anchors to that baseline’s paired text encoder. The Base row is our SAM 2 + SigLIP 2 map without refinement, the reference practice of existing open-vocabulary maps. blocks.en: Our initial attempt, a training-free entropy-based post-processing, degraded mIoU on two language maps. The failure originates in the 2D features themselves. Even where a target region is segmented almost perfectly, the text-cosine ranks the correct word far down the list, so the region does not win its own query. A global post-hoc reweighting cannot fix this, which is why we inject the target text directly, small and selective, to preserve the original discriminability.
blocks.zh: 我们的最初尝试,一个无训练的Entropy 后处理, 退化mIoU 在两种语言地图上。 失败起源于2D自身特征. 即使一个目标区域被分割得几乎完美无缺,文本cosine也将正确的单词排到列表下方,因此这个区域没有赢得自己的查询. 全球性的后重压不能解决这个问题,这就是为什么我们直接地、小地和有选择性地注入目标文本,以保持最初的歧视性。

blocks.en: Our target-aware refinement instead raises the SAM 2+SigLIP 2 base from 0.207 0.207 to 0.436 0.436 mIoU on Replica. Most of the gain comes from targets the base misses entirely, such as picture, vase, and rug, which the refinement recovers from near-zero IoU to well above 0.4 0.4 , while already-retrieved classes are preserved. The injection stays small and adaptive, with a mean strength of α ¯ ∗ = 0.17 \bar{\alpha}^{*}=0.17 . Classes never detected by SAM 3 remain at zero, so the residual bottleneck there is the text-promptable segmenter’s recall rather than the injection mechanism.
blocks.zh: 相反,我们的目标意识改进将SAM 2+SigLIP 2基由0.207 0.207提高到0.436 04.36 mIoU。 大部分收益来自完全被忽略的目标,如图片,花瓶和地毯,而精度从接近零的IoU恢复到远高于0.4的0.4,而已经恢复的类则被保留. 注射量保持小而有适应性,平均强度为 α → = 0.17\ bar'alpha}^{*}=0.17。 SAM 3从未检测到的分级仍然为零,所以剩下的瓶颈是文本速率分级器的召回,而不是注射机制.

blocks.en: The refinement also works as a plug-in on off-the-shelf maps, where the only change is that the text anchors come from each map’s own text encoder. On LangSplat it raises mIoU by 79 % 79\% to 123 % 123\% across the three datasets. On Feature-3DGS it lifts mIoU by 23 % 23\% on Replica and 34 % 34\% on HM3D-Sem, improving all twelve of their scenes, and by a more modest 4.0 4.0 points on ScanNet. The injected strength adapts to the base, shrinking where the base is already strong, with a correlation of − 0.80 -0.80 between base mIoU and mean strength across all scenes of the three datasets, so the gains concentrate where the base is weak.
blocks.zh: 精细化还起到在现成地图上插入的作用,其中唯一的变化是文本锚地来自每个地图自己的文本编码器. 在LangSplat上,这三套数据集的mIoU提升了79% 79%到123%. 在Feature-3DGS上,它将mIoU在复制版上提升了23% 23%,在HM3D-Sem上提升了34% 34%,改善了他们所有12个场景,并在ScanNet上提升了更谦虚的4.0 4.0分. 被注入的强度能适应基部,在已经是基部强能的地方会收缩,基部mIoU之间的相关性为−0.80-0.80,在三个数据集的所有场景中均值强度,因此收益集中在基部薄弱的地方.

blocks.en: IV-C Why minimal injection
blocks.zh: IV-C 为何注射最少

blocks.en: A natural question is why we do not paste the target text directly at α = 1 \alpha{=}1 or pick one fixed α \alpha for every target. On the closed-set metric, mIoU rises monotonically with injection strength and the α = 1 \alpha{=}1 hard paste is highest (Table 4 ). Our adaptive refinement reaches 0.436 0.436 on Replica, higher than any fixed α \alpha of comparable mean strength and within 8 % 8\% of the hard paste. But this metric can be gamed, since it rewards pasting the very word it scores against, so a larger α \alpha is favored regardless of whether the region still carries any appearance.
blocks.zh: 一个自然的问题是,我们为什么不将目标文本直接粘贴在α = 1\ alpha = 1 或为每个目标选择一个固定的α\ alpha. 在闭合定格度量上,mIoU单调地以注射强度上升,而α = 1\ alpha{=}1硬面是最高的(表4). 我们的适应性改进在复制品上达到0.436 0.436, 高于任何固定的α-α的可比较平均强度, 且在硬糊面的8%至8%以内。 但是这个衡量标准可以被玩弄,因为它奖励粘贴它得分的字眼,所以无论这个区域是否还带有任何外表,一个更大的α-α都会得到青睐.

blocks.en: The cost of hard paste appears as soon as a query needs appearance. Replica room0 contains nine cushions of different colors. Under α = 1 \alpha{=}1 their per-instance features collapse to essentially one vector, with mean pairwise cosine 0.999 0.999 , so “blue cushion” cannot prefer the blue ones in principle. Under the differential relevancy cos ⁡ ( z , f ⁡ ( q ) ) − cos ⁡ ( z , f ⁡ ( class ) ) \cos(z,f(q))-\cos(z,f(\text{class})) , which cancels the class component, the hard paste ranks neither blue cushion first, whereas our adaptive map preserves base-level appearance diversity, pairwise cosine 0.883 0.883 vs base 0.873 0.873 , and ranks the two blue cushions top-2, matching the uninjected base (Fig. 4 ). In short, adaptive α ∗ \alpha^{*} retains most of the closed-set gain while keeping the visual information that hard paste burns.

blocks.en: A complementary held-out analysis makes the same point at the open-vocabulary level (Table III ), reported in mAcc since held-out mIoU is dominated by a few large background classes. Across all three datasets a larger fixed α \alpha trades held-out accuracy for target accuracy, degrading the held-out classes monotonically, by up to 26 % 26\% on Replica, 16 % 16\% on ScanNet, and 28 % 28\% on HM3D-Sem at α = 1 \alpha{=}1 . Our adaptive map instead keeps the held-out loss small, from − 8 % -8\% on Replica and ScanNet to − 14 % -14\% on the fine-grained HM3D-Sem set, while still capturing most of the target gain, a better trade-off than any fixed α \alpha of comparable target gain. Minimal, adaptive injection is what preserves open-vocabulary performance beyond the target set.

blocks.en: We evaluate language-goal localization directly with an instance-aware success rate, reported at top- K K for K = 1 ​ … ​ 5 K{=}1\ldots 5 . A predicted candidate counts as a hit if it lands within 1 1 m of any ground-truth instance of the queried class, following the official success radius of the Habitat ObjectNav challenge [ 1 ] , also used by GOAT-Bench [ 14 ] . For the query vocabulary we adopt the 20 20 object categories of the HOV-SG object-level localization benchmark [ 32 ] . Following HOV-SG, each scene is queried only with the categories present in its ground-truth annotation, with dataset-native synonyms mapped to the shared vocabulary 1 1 1 sofa → \to couch, cushion → \to pillow, indoor-plant → \to plant, painting → \to picture, pot → \to flowerpot, tv-screen and television → \to tv, books → \to book, night stand → \to nightstand, stair → \to stairs, plus trivial spelling variants. , which yields 56 56 queries on Replica, 70 70 on ScanNet, and 49 49 on HM3D-Sem, 175 175 in total. Candidates are extracted with the clustering read-out of Sec. III-D . The Base rows apply the same clustering to the raw cosine scores, retrieving goals by raw similarity as existing language maps do [ 7 , 28 , 36 , 32 ] , so the base stands in for the practice of these systems. Running such systems end to end would change the underlying map together with the read-out, whereas holding our map fixed isolates the effect of the refinement and of the centering from the representation itself. Since the goal coordinate comes directly from the map, the agent follows the shortest path to it, path efficiency is near-optimal by construction, and SPL reduces to the success rate, which we therefore report alone.

blocks.en: Table 5 exposes a failure mode and its fix. Applying the refined map with the standard cosine read-out, Ours w/o centering, collapses far below the base on all three datasets, on ScanNet from 72.9 72.9 to 30.0 30.0 at top-1, because injection makes the map query-agnostic. As Fig. 6 shows, the per-Gaussian similarities of different query words become almost perfectly correlated, with the scene-averaged cross-query correlation growing from 0.28 0.28 to 0.98 0.98 . Injection inflates a shared common mode that dwarfs the query-specific variation, raising the average similarity of every Gaussian to all queries from 0.056 0.056 to 0.233 0.233 , so every query retrieves the same dominant injected object. The centering step of Sec. III-D removes this common mode. It helps the base only modestly, by 3.4 3.4 points at top-1 over the 175 175 queries, because the base has little common mode to remove, but on the refined map it is decisive.
blocks.zh: 表5显示故障模式及其固定。 用标准的余弦读出,Ours w/o Centering,在ScanNet上从72.9 72.9到30.0 30.0在上到上1,因为注射使得地图查询-可知性远低于基础. 如图6所显示,不同查询词的相近性几乎完全相关,场景平均相克的相克关系从0.280.28增长到0.980.980.98. 注射膨胀出一个共享的共通模式来矮化查询特定变异,将每个高斯人与所有查询的平均相似度从0.0560.056提高到0.2330.233,因此每个查询都检索到相同的主导注射对象. blocks.en: Beyond this controlled comparison, Table V runs the object-level HOV-SG and ConceptGraphs end to end. Both are strong on the furniture-scale queries of ScanNet, where one clean feature per detected object avoids the context mixing of dense distillation, but collapse on the small, cluttered targets of Replica, where their mapping never instantiates the queried objects, so ours leads both by a wide margin on the aggregate, 64.0 64.0 vs 46.3 46.3 and 37.7 37.7 at top-1. Injection transfers the refinement to this map family as well, raising the aggregate top-1 of HOV-SG to 52.0 52.0 and of ConceptGraphs to 46.3 46.3 . The one block that does not improve is Replica, since the injection edits regions that already exist in the map and cannot create the missing small-object instances, which is precisely what the dense field representation provides.

blocks.en: We deploy the full pipeline on a real building floor with a Unitree Go2 quadruped, shown in Fig. . A handheld rig sweeps the floor once, a LiDAR-inertial SLAM system [ 29 ] estimates the sensor poses, and the posed RGB frames are lifted into a 3DGS language map by the same feature-splatting solver [ 34 ] and refined by our method, so the map construction is identical to the simulated setting. At run time the user issues a free-form natural-language request, a language-model front end selects the matching target word from the map’s vocabulary, and the centered read-out turns that word into a 3D goal on the refined map. The robot localizes itself against the LiDAR map and plans toward the goal with A ∗ on a 2D occupancy grid, so the language map supplies the goal and the LiDAR map supplies the pose and the grid in one shared frame. The refined map guides the robot to the correct object with a success rate of 78 % 78\% , whereas the base map with the standard raw-similarity read-out reaches 22 % 22\% , and the margin comes mostly from the more specific queries on which the base map fails.

blocks.en: V CONCLUSIONS
blocks.zh: 五. 结论

blocks.en: We presented a training-free, target-aware refinement of 3D Gaussian language maps that makes user-specified targets reliably retrievable while keeping the map open-vocabulary. Each target’s injection strength is obtained in closed form, so the refinement introduces no hyperparameters, and a centered read-out removes the query-agnostic common mode that injection plants, turning the refined map into a dependable source of language-goal locations. Across three benchmarks the same refinement improves both open-vocabulary segmentation and localization, and the gain carries over to a legged robot that navigates to natural-language goals on a real building floor. Because the refinement acts on per-view features before lifting, it drops into existing language-map pipelines, and extending it to online mapping and to targets observed only sparsely is a natural next step.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了对3D高斯语语言地图的无培训、有目标意识的改进,使用户指定的目标可以可靠地检索,同时保持地图的公开性。 每个目标的注射强度都是以封闭的形式获得的,因此精度的改进没有引入高参数,而以中心读出会去掉注射厂的查询-不可知常见模式,将精度的地图变成语言-目标地点的可靠来源. 在三个基准中,同样的改进改进既改进了开放的省道分界,也改进了本地化,而收益则延续到一个脚步机器人上,在真正的建筑楼层上通向自然语言目标。 由于在升起前的精细化作用于每个视野的特征,它会掉入现有的语言-映射管中,并将它扩展到在线映射和仅很少观察到的目标上,这自然是下一个步骤.
